div.span:
auth = strength · 0.5^((now − lastAuth) / 5 min)
score = 0.35·auth
+ 0.25·posture
+ 0.30·(1 − anomaly)
+ 0.10·location
− 0.1 · denials · 0.5^(Δt / 10 min)

anomaly, location: EWMA with α = 0.5
compromised ⇒ 0 · never authenticated ⇒ 0 · NaN ⇒ 0 · clamp [0, 1]
